signature_moves: Wallpaper-as-footage: Lab grades the desktop background like video (Noir/Cinematic-Teal/Cyber-Neon LUT presets + Scanline/Grain sliders); Active Wall does per-frame selection and loop-range scrubbing
3D coverflow theme browser — the app's most memorable gesture and its clearest (non-native) brand signature
Content-mirrors-chrome: moody purple/blue-black dark UI chosen so the app disappears into the lofi/vaporwave imagery it manages
defects: Non-native density (iOS sizing in a Mac frame) — ~40pt titles, ~66pt action cards, ~15-17pt nav; systematic tell, excluded from macOS canon
Tracked-uppercase section headers (PRESETS / MANUAL CONTROL) — HIG wants system-font semibold sentence/title case
Coverflow for primary browsing — Jakob's Law violation; only the focal card is legible (discoverability cost)
Selection-grammar drift — blue-translucent fill + blue label instead of native flat gray inset
Contrast Dilution (rubric #10) — unfilled slider tracks + preset-card borders <3:1 on #2B inspector; low-contrast coverflow chevrons

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product dark bent toward consumer media — dark neutral ramp + system-blue accent, but styled as a VJ/grading rig rather than a calm dev tool; imagery-forward
peers: media apps that lean on cover art (Spotify-ish full-bleed cards)

psychology: Aesthetic-Usability Effect — leans hard on beautiful lofi imagery to carry perceived quality; the UI intentionally recedes behind the art
Von Restorff / single-accent — one green 'Done' among gray action cards makes the commit obvious; correct action singularity
Jakob's Law (violated) — coverflow + oversized iOS chrome defy Mac conventions users arrive expecting
Hick's Law (respected) — Grading presets capped at 6 tiles; coverflow shows one focal choice at a time
Serial-position / spatial memory — coverflow relies on position recall, but hides flanking options (recognition cost)
notes: Lineage is the load-bearing call: real Mac frame (genuine traffic lights, 3-pane split, native sliders) wrapping an iOS-density body (coverflow, ~40pt titles, ~66pt buttons, tracked-uppercase headers) => catalyst/iOS-influenced, med confidence; none of its density/selection/coverflow evidence should feed macOS canon. Dark mode only — no light surface, no Preferences/Settings window, no text-field or menu surface digested. cover.png is a marketing composite (brand evidence only). All numeric tokens are @2x screenshot estimates; single app => evidence (inferred). The recurring lofi-girl 'SILENCE' art is content, not app typography.
